tools.name: explain_lab_result
tools.description: Explains one lab test value in plain words (for example HbA1c 6.1 %, TSH 6.2, platelets 90,000, creatinine 1.4): the usual normal range, what this value usually means, and when to see a clinician. General information from MedDroid, not a diagnosis.

tools.name: explain_lab_report
tools.description: Explains a whole lab report pasted as text (CBC, LFT, KFT, lipid profile, thyroid, sugar, dengue, urine): what it is, every value outside the normal range marked High or Low with what it usually means, what looks normal, and questions to ask a clinician.

tools.name: explain_prescription
tools.description: For each medicine on a prescription pasted as text: what it is usually used for, how it is to be taken as written (OD, BD, 1-0-1…), common cautions, and questions to ask. Never changes a dose.

tools.name: when_to_seek_care
tools.description: Given symptoms, gives the safe next step: emergency now, see a clinician within 24 hours, see a clinician in the next few days, or home care is reasonable, with warning signs to watch. General guidance, not a diagnosis; always errs on the side of safety.

tools.name: find_clinics_near
tools.description: Finds hospitals, clinics, labs or pharmacies near a place (city, area or address) from OpenStreetMap, nearest first, with address, phone if listed and a directions link.

tools.name: find_teleconnect_clinicians
tools.description: Finds verified MedDroid TeleConnect clinicians for video consults by speciality, language, city or name, with their fee and a profile link to see free times and book.

tools.name: teleconnect_booking_link
tools.description: Gives the booking link for one TeleConnect clinician (by handle from find_teleconnect_clinicians). The person picks a time, shares details and pays on MedDroid.

tools.name: food_calories
tools.description: Estimates calories, protein, carbs and fat for a described meal or portion, including Indian foods (e.g. "2 idli with sambar and coconut chutney"). Estimates only.

tools.name: health_calculators
tools.description: BMI (with Asian cut-offs), pregnancy due date, ovulation and fertile window, daily water intake, and heart-rate training zones. Plain maths, no AI.

tools.name: find_health_guide
tools.description: Searches MedDroid's free health guides (about 1,000 pages: diseases A–Z, medicines A–Z, lab report readers, 'X vs Y' comparisons, BP, sugar, thyroid, fever, dengue) and returns the best links.

tools.name: health_connect_devices
tools.description: Which health devices work with MedDroid Health Connect (Bluetooth heart-rate straps, BP monitors, pulse oximeters, weight scales, thermometers; Apple Health import) and how to connect them.

tools.name: meddroid_apps
tools.description: Lists MedDroid's free apps: personal health apps (medicine reminder, BP & sugar diary, pregnancy, child growth, food calories…) and clinic apps (EMR, lab, pharmacy, billing, teleconsult…), with links.

tools.name: clinic_savings_estimate
tools.description: For clinic and hospital owners: estimated yearly software cost today versus MedDroid Providers + Sync OS, from number of doctors, beds and the systems they need. Always an estimate.

tools.name: meddroid_info
tools.description: What MedDroid is: the free AI Health OS for families, plans and prices, MedDroid Providers and Sync OS for clinics, downloads and contact.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "when_to_seek_care" stacks urgency/override words (always, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
